feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: From public preferences to clinical tasks in anti-amyloid therapy for Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 日本患者对仑卡奈单抗的获益期望远超实际疗效，临床需全程管理预期。

drug.title: Clinical immunology lessons from failed α-Synuclein and Tau immunotherapies: A roadmap for combination strategies in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: α-Synuclein和Tau免疫治疗失败揭示四大教训，指明AD需生物标志物分层与联合免疫策略。

drug.title: Beyond Amyloid: Systemic and Brain Frailty as Determinants of Response to Anti-Amyloid Therapy in Alzheimer's Disease-A Conceptual Review.
drug.zh: 系统性与脑衰弱决定抗淀粉样疗法疗效，而非仅看淀粉样病理。

drug.title: Exosome-Based Therapeutics in Alzheimer's Disease: Translational Perspectives Beyond Conventional Therapies.
drug.zh: 外泌体疗法凭借血脑屏障穿透力与多靶点递送优势，有望突破现有AD治疗瓶颈。

drug.title: Cerebral amyloid-β burden and white matter injury: associations, clues for underlying mechanisms, and implication on cognitive trajectory after lecanemab therapy.
drug.zh: 仑卡奈单抗疗效受白质损伤影响，Aβ负荷驱动WMH进展并介导认知轨迹。

drug.title: A Metabolomics-Based Strategy for Identifying Endogenous Inhibitors of IAPP Aggregation.
drug.zh: 代谢组学筛选出内源性IAPP聚集抑制剂，为T2DM治疗提供新靶点。

drug.title: Donanemab for early symptomatic AD in the UK-indicated population: safety and efficacy in those who are non-carriers or heterozygous for APOE ε4.
drug.zh: 英国获批人群中，多奈单抗对APOE ε4非携带者及杂合子早期症状性AD患者安全且有效。

drug.title: Anti-amyloid drugs: Integrated clinical pathways for treating older patients with frailty and dementia.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样药物对衰弱痴呆老人疗效有限，应将其作为分层维度而非排除标准。

mech.title: Association Between Alzheimer Pathology, Sleep, and Cognition in Patients With Late-Onset Unexplained Epilepsy.
mech.zh: 血浆p-tau217升高与晚发不明原因癫痫患者认知下降相关，且该效应部分由睡眠障碍介导。

mech.title: Cross-tissue immune profiling of APOE ε4 reveals early dysregulation in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: APOE ε4通过基因剂量效应驱动跨组织早期免疫炎症失调，先于淀粉样蛋白和tau病理出现。

mech.title: Longitudinal plasma phosphorylated tau217 classification and the association with Alzheimer's disease progression.
mech.zh: 血浆p-tau217基线阈值可稳定预测Aβ-PET阳性及阿尔茨海默病进展风险。

mech.title: Higher Frontal Cortex Angiotensin Type 2 Receptor-Interacting Protein (ATIP) Levels Are Associated With a Lower Amyloid-Beta Burden in Postmortem Brains of Older Adults With Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: 阿尔茨海默病患者额叶皮层ATIP水平越高，淀粉样蛋白沉积越少。

mech.title: Promoting Effect of (+)-Borneol on Alzheimer's Disease Treatment in APP Transgenic Zebrafish and Its Blood-Brain Barrier Permeation Mechanism.
mech.zh: 冰片下调紧密连接蛋白与P-gp，促进抗AD药物入脑并增强疗效。

mech.title: AMBMP Hydrochloride Reverses STZ-Induced Alzheimer-Type Dementia Associated with Wnt/β-catenin/TLR4 Signaling.
mech.zh: AMBMP Hydrochloride通过激活Wnt/β-catenin并抑制TLR4炎症通路，逆转STZ诱导的阿尔茨海默样认知障碍。

mech.title: Learning precise segmentation of neurofibrillary tangles from rapid manual point annotations.
mech.zh: 基于单点标注的深度学习模型可精准分割神经原纤维缠结，实现阿尔茨海默病病理高通量量化。

mech.title: Fabrication of Mesoporous Manganese Nanoparticles Incorporated Aβ-Peptide Inhibits Aβ Aggregation and Alleviates Neuroinflammation Against Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: 介孔锰纳米载体共递送Aβ与Tau双靶点肽，穿越血脑屏障并缓解神经炎症。

dx.title: Association Between Alzheimer Pathology, Sleep, and Cognition in Patients With Late-Onset Unexplained Epilepsy.
dx.zh: 晚发不明原因癫痫患者中，血浆p-tau217升高与认知下降相关，且该效应由睡眠障碍介导。

dx.title: Longitudinal plasma phosphorylated tau217 classification and the association with Alzheimer's disease progression.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217基线阈值可稳定预测Aβ-PET阳性及AD进展，中间区间者转阳风险高。

dx.title: Analytical validation and clinical performance of a chemiluminescence immunoassay panel for plasma biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease: a preliminary study.
dx.zh: 六项血浆生物标志物化学发光联合检测可有效区分AD、其他痴呆及MCI，具临床诊断潜力。

dx.title: Plasma p-tau217 as a two-cutoff approach to improve tau-PET screening and trial recruitment in Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217双阈值策略可精准筛出tau-PET阳性，显著减少灰区不确定分类。

dx.title: Clinical impact of amyloid PET in memory clinic: A 2-year longitudinal real-world study in Taiwan.
dx.zh: 台湾记忆门诊队列研究显示，淀粉样蛋白PET可显著改变近半数患者的临床诊断。

dx.title: A Scoping Review of Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Alzheimer's Disease Using Blood Biomarkers.
dx.zh: 血液生物标志物结合机器学习可提升阿尔茨海默病早期预测准确性，但面临数据异质性等挑战。

dx.title: Diagnostic accuracy of plasma p-tau217 against amyloid PET: A meta-analysis of technical platform variability and ratio versus single marker comparisons.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217诊断淀粉样病变总体准确率高，但平台间差异显著，联合Aβ42比值未显著提升诊断效能。

dx.title: Multiplexed EDL-FET biosensor with tannic acid stabilization for simultaneous p-Tau217 and Aβ42/Aβ40 detection in plasma and whole blood from stroke patients.
dx.zh: 单宁酸稳定的八通道EDL-FET生物传感器可同时检测血浆及全血中p-Tau217与Aβ42/Aβ40，助力卒中患者AD早筛。

prev.title: Cross-tissue immune profiling of APOE ε4 reveals early dysregulation in Alzheimer's disease.
prev.zh: APOE ε4通过剂量依赖的跨组织促炎免疫特征，在淀粉样病理出现前即驱动AD早期免疫失调。

prev.title: Associations of diabetes status and physical activity with cognitive impairment and hippocampal volume in older adults.
prev.journal: The Journal of clinical endocrinology an
prev.zh: 糖尿病患者即使保持中高强度运动，认知障碍风险仍显著升高且海马体积更小。

prev.title: Associations between diet quality, epigenetic aging and epigenome in two population-based cohorts.
prev.zh: 不同健康饮食评分重叠度低，且与表观遗传衰老及DNA甲基化的关联各异。

prev.title: The Dietary Inflammatory Index is Lower Among Healthy Older Adults Consuming a Walnut-Supplemented Diet. Ancillary Results from the Walnuts and Healthy Aging Randomized Controlled Trial.
prev.journal: Journal of the Academy of Nutrition and
prev.zh: 每日补充核桃可显著降低老年人饮食炎症指数，改善抗炎状态。

prev.title: Incidence of Dementia in Older Adults Hospitalized With Acute Coronary Syndrome: Insights From KP-Brain-Heart Health Study.
prev.zh: ACS患者未血运重建者痴呆风险最高，血运重建策略不影响痴呆发生率。

prev.title: APOE ε4 and peripheral metabolic network architecture in older adults.
prev.zh: APOE ε4携带者外周代谢网络结构显著不同，提示其痴呆预防需基因分型定制策略。

prev.title: Age-Dependent and APOE-Modified Associations Between Vascular Risk Factor Patterns and Cognitive Function: A Latent Class Analysis of 44,879 NACC Participants.
prev.zh: 血管风险因子模式与认知的关联随年龄及APOE基因型显著改变。

prev.title: Transcriptomic analysis reveals and validates lipid raft-associated biomarkers and functional networks in Alzheimer's disease.
prev.zh: 脂筏相关基因网络与八项生物标志物可作AD诊断及机制研究新靶点。

intro.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
intro.zh: 科学家用干细胞造出大脑模型，帮我们看清老年痴呆怎么发生，好提前找药。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这文章讲的是用一滴血查老年痴呆，比抽脑脊液便宜又轻松，以后体检就能早发现早干预。

intro.title: Microglia in Alzheimer's disease: Insights into disease progression and therapy.
intro.zh: 大脑里的清洁工“小胶质细胞”一旦吃错油、发炎罢工，就会加速老年痴呆，搞懂它才能找到新药方向。

intro.title: Menopausal insomnia as a modifiable node of dementia risk: Mechanistic insights and intervention strategies.
intro.zh: 更年期睡不好可能增加老年痴呆风险，但睡好觉、调激素，就能给大脑上保险，提前防住它。

intro.title: Advances in the clinical application of mesenchymal stem cells for neurological disorders.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用干细胞治疗老年痴呆等脑部疾病，目前看安全可行，但效果还在验证中，普通人了解个大概就行。

intro.title: Gantenerumab for Early Alzheimer's Disease: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
intro.zh: 这药想清除大脑里的“垃圾蛋白”来延缓早期痴呆，但新数据说效果一般，别指望它能治好，只能算个尝试。

intro.title: Distinct roles of AMPA receptor subunits as potential therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑里负责记忆的“信号开关”出了问题，导致老年痴呆，并介绍了未来可能修复这个开关的新药思路。

intro.title: Peroxynitrite: A potential therapeutic target for Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，一种叫“过氧亚硝酸盐”的坏分子在老年痴呆里捣乱，科学家正研究怎么拦住它，将来可能帮病人延缓病情。
